status_summary: The Made in America Office remains part of OMB: its public website (madeinamerica.gov) describes waiver review by the office and the domestic content thresholds and refers to the current President's Made in America policies. A final FAR rule effective 2025-06-11 shortened the list of articles presumed unavailable domestically, which the FAR Councils said would strengthen the domestic industrial base, with the office expected to support waiver consistency. EO 14392 (signed 2026-03-13) directed procurement agencies to verify American-origin claims on government-wide contracts. No order was found revoking EO 14005; the office's staffing and any formal strengthening could not be verified.

timeline.event: FAR final rule published shortening the domestically nonavailable articles list (effective 2025-06-11).
EO 14392 signed: agencies to prioritize enforcement of false Made in America claims and verify origin claims on government-wide contracts.

title: Continue and strengthen the Made in America Office's Buy American work
